propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and depends on field values for drift classification, but narrowing prev to a key-set ({jira_key: {}}) causes silent degradation of field-based classification
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of prev_snapshot.json that reads the working tree directly, not ctx.prev_snapshot, so standard reconcile_once tests do not exercise it
bridge_fsck must report drift classification as indeterminate rather than inferring from empty dicts when field values are required for classification
Against key-set prev fixtures, bridge_fsck drift classification must match full-payload behavior for membership-only cases and report indeterminate for field-dependent cases
bridge_fsck exit code, JSON shape, and report behavior must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload prev snapshots
